correctness.rationale: Width is additive over Minkowski-summed simplices; exact nested-level decomposition gives strict cut reduction. Count yields W(s,t), and minimization at central cardinalities follows from the convex exponential g-functions. For n>=128 the 16/9 tail bound proves strict dominance over all noncentral cuts, including the singleton and k=2 boundaries. For 4<=n<=127 all 3906 bicliques and 5870718 cut profiles were exhaustively compared with exact arbitrary-precision integers by included verify.py, whose source and output were checked. Independent small tube enumeration validates the combinatorial count. No infinity is inferred from finite numerics.

value.rationale: The standard complete-bipartite nestohedron has exponentially many tubes. Intrinsic minimum width and the equality directions are geometric invariants not determined by its skeleton diameter or inradius. A universal order-15 cut-orbit phase crossing valid for every aspect ratio is a natural sharp extremal boundary, and the theorem also gives exact values, all minimizers and fixed-one-side asymptotics. It is not a parameter substitution from the star result because nontrivial bicliques have different two-color tube counts and distinct optimizing cut classes.
